program.title: Security-state organism evidence program
program.working_proposition: A post-2001 counterterrorism architecture for population capture, identity resolution, classification, persistent tracking, decision production, enforcement, and feedback was progressively generalized into border, police, administrative, military, and allied operating systems. The program tests whether nominally separate companies, funds, banks, policy institutions, personnel networks, government gateways, and deployment theaters were deliberately assembled as complementary organs of a transnational population-control architecture, whether that architecture was intentionally obscured through legal and functional fragmentation, and who retained authority and residual value.
program.strongest_claim_under_test: The named public-private network was purpose-built to convert exceptional counterterrorism capabilities into a durable transnational population-governance system while distributing authorship and accountability across separate legal entities and institutions.

minimum_features: classification, relationship inference, or risk attribution
decision, case, target, eligibility, or intervention production
coercive, restrictive, allocative, or kinetic consequence
weak, opaque, or costly inspection, appeal, substitution, or exit
private retention of revenue, equity, intellectual property, data position, governance rights, or strategic control
operational_definition.completion_rule: No architecture-level finding may be made unless every asserted transition is independently receipted and the ordinary, unsuccessful, and contradictory paths are preserved.

lineage_stages.label: Population and environment capture
lineage_stages.question: What data, signal, image, communication, transaction, movement, biometric, sensor, or administrative record entered the system, under what authority, and at what population scale?

lineage_stages.label: Identity resolution
lineage_stages.question: How were people, devices, entities, locations, accounts, and relationships joined, and what error, correction, and contest mechanisms existed?

lineage_stages.label: Classification and relationship inference
lineage_stages.question: Which ontologies, categories, scores, models, or analyst rules assigned meaning, suspicion, eligibility, priority, or affiliation?

lineage_stages.label: Persistent tracking
lineage_stages.question: How did the system maintain temporal continuity, detect change, reconstruct history, or monitor a person, unit, asset, organization, or population over time?

lineage_stages.label: Decision, case, or target production
lineage_stages.question: How did data and classifications become a recommendation, case, watchlist entry, resource allocation, operational plan, target, or administrative decision?

lineage_stages.label: Enforcement or effect
lineage_stages.question: Which public or private actor executed the restriction, denial, detention, investigation, interception, strike, benefit decision, contract action, or other consequence?

lineage_stages.label: Outcome feedback and adaptation
lineage_stages.question: How did operational results, battlefield telemetry, user behavior, appeals, errors, or enforcement outcomes update products, models, doctrine, procurement, or resource allocation?

lineage_stages.label: Export, replication, and normalization
lineage_stages.question: Which product, method, person, standard, procurement mechanism, doctrine, or metric moved between theaters and became routine or permanent?

organ_types.label: Doctrine and legitimation
organ_types.function: Defines the threat, mission, moral vocabulary, urgency, and institutional future that makes the architecture appear necessary.

organ_types.label: Convening and policy translation
organ_types.function: Creates the rooms, cohorts, advisory surfaces, and policy translations that make selected actors and product categories legible to government.

organ_types.label: Capital and company formation
organ_types.function: Selects founders, finances complementary companies, supplies governance and information rights, and supports repeated company creation.

organ_types.label: Banking and financial rails
organ_types.function: Provides deposits, lending, payments, treasury, crypto, and financial continuity to the selected technology and defense ecosystem.

organ_types.label: Identity, data, and ontology
organ_types.function: Integrates records, resolves identities, defines objects and relationships, and controls the institutional representation of reality.

organ_types.label: Persistent sensing and surveillance
organ_types.function: Captures physical, digital, geospatial, biometric, communications, and environmental signals.

organ_types.label: Communications, space, compute, and models
organ_types.function: Supplies connectivity, hosting, accreditation, compute, models, and the infrastructure required for continuous operation.

organ_types.label: Decision, command, and workflow
organ_types.function: Turns data and classifications into cases, priorities, workflows, command decisions, target packages, and resource allocations.

organ_types.label: Effectors and enforcement
organ_types.function: Executes physical, administrative, financial, legal, border, police, or military consequences.

organ_types.label: Manufacturing and physical infrastructure
organ_types.function: Builds sensors, autonomous systems, factories, energy, tunnels, vehicles, facilities, and other physical capacity.

organ_types.label: Public gates and permanent institutions
organ_types.function: Supplies authority, procurement, accreditation, data, subsidy, standards, mandates, and durable institutional adoption.

organ_types.label: Personnel routing
organ_types.function: Moves tacit knowledge, trust, access, technical expertise, and decision experience across public, private, military, capital, and policy roles.

organ_types.label: Deployment and proving grounds
organ_types.function: Provides real populations, operational environments, conflicts, borders, agencies, and institutions in which systems are deployed, adapted, and validated.

organ_types.label: Residual rights and ownership
organ_types.function: Retains equity, recurring revenue, intellectual property, data position, governance rights, contract options, land, and strategic market power.

organ_types.label: Counterpower, inspection, and exit
organ_types.function: Audits, adjudicates, appeals, substitutes, terminates, migrates, corrects, or otherwise limits the architecture.

organism_tests.label: Common purpose
organism_tests.proof: Actor-specific doctrine and strategy converge on the same institutional future and are connected to organizational action.
organism_tests.falsifier: The apparent doctrine is generic, contradictory, or cannot be connected to decisions or design.

organism_tests.label: Organ differentiation
organism_tests.proof: Nominally separate entities deliberately perform complementary, nonredundant functions in the same operating chain.
organism_tests.falsifier: The entities are ordinary competitors or unrelated suppliers with no functional closure.

organism_tests.label: Resource metabolism
organism_tests.proof: Public authority, data, risk, subsidy, and demand repeatedly flow into private revenue, equity, rights, and renewed gate-shaping capacity.
organism_tests.falsifier: Private risk is proportionate, public rights are strong, and returns do not depend materially on public market creation.

organism_tests.label: Coordination and integration
organism_tests.proof: Governance, capital, personnel, contracts, APIs, interoperability records, or joint operations connect the organs.
organism_tests.falsifier: Shared investors, customers, or personnel do not produce common design or operational integration.

organism_tests.label: Institutional reproduction
organism_tests.proof: The network repeatedly creates new companies, vehicles, banks, cohorts, or standards that fill missing functions in the architecture.
organism_tests.falsifier: New entities arise from ordinary market opportunity without coordinated formation or complementary role design.

organism_tests.label: Feedback and adaptation
organism_tests.proof: Operational results in one theater measurably alter product design, doctrine, procurement, standards, financing, or deployment elsewhere.
organism_tests.falsifier: Changes are independently developed or the asserted transfer cannot be temporally and technically established.

organism_tests.label: Strategic invisibility and accountability membrane
organism_tests.proof: Legal, semantic, contractual, geographic, or organizational fragmentation systematically prevents end-to-end reconstruction while preserving integrated function.
organism_tests.falsifier: The architecture, responsibility, control rights, and consequences are fully disclosed and independently inspectable.

organism_tests.label: Coercive governance and extraction
organism_tests.proof: The integrated system materially constrains populations or institutions while private actors retain disproportionate authority or residual value.
organism_tests.falsifier: Use is voluntary or contestable, alternatives remain practical, consequences are independently governed, and public recovery and exit rights work.

evidence_levels.label: Complementary formation
evidence_levels.meaning: Doctrine, capital, governance, personnel, or strategy records show deliberate construction of complementary entities or roles.

evidence_levels.label: Operational integration

evidence_levels.label: Coercive population effect

evidence_levels.label: Private extraction
evidence_levels.meaning: Exact ownership, governance, public-risk allocation, and decision chronology connect the architecture to disproportionate private gain or control.

required_outputs: complete capital, governance, and personnel denominators
population-control chain with affected-population and consequence records
compulsion, appeal, substitution, and exit matrix
completion_law: Every named candidate must be resolved to exact people, legal entities, vehicles, programs, or explicitly unresolved aliases.
Every asserted organism link must name the organ, lineage transition, source record, date window, and alternative explanation.
Every operational claim must identify the affected population or institution, decision rule, human discretion, consequence, appeal, and exit.
Every theater transfer must identify the object transferred and the sending and receiving records; shared branding or personnel is insufficient.
Every intentionality proposition must be adjudicated separately from structural effect and commercial benefit.
Every program packet must preserve nulls, unsuccessful actors, ordinary comparators, contradictions, and source restrictions.
No workflow, visualization, network position, or aggregate count may generate an organism finding.
No package routing may be created from array position, modulo arithmetic, count balancing, round-robin assignment, or another synthetic coverage heuristic.
Unresolved entity, estate, organ, lineage, theater, route, consequence, or transfer targets must remain explicitly unresolved until a source record selects them.
A deterministic build proves only reproducibility of the declared source state; it does not prove factual completeness or evidentiary coverage.
